Check the results

Change anything the activity got wrong — a bad barcode on file, an item the student really did find, a package that was not on the shelf. The score above updates as you go. Choose Don't count this one and the item drops out of the score completely.

Today at this station

Clearing this list only tidies the screen. Every round stays in the running record below, and in Setup you can print, back up or delete that record.

Student progress

Everything a student has done at this station, added up across every session - not just today.

QR code for this page

A student points a camera at this and the activity opens — no typing, no address to remember. It uses whatever web address this page is sitting at, so put the page on your site first, then open it there and print this.

Check barcodes against the real packages

Walk the shelf and scan each package. The page tells you straight away whether that code is the one it has stored, and lets you fix it on the spot. Worth doing once for the whole store — a tag printed with a box or case code will not match the single item a student picks up.

Scan with a handheld scanner, or type a code below.
This code is not stored for any product:
Tags most likely to need checking

The running record

Every finished round is kept here with the student's name, so progress adds up across sessions. "Clear this list for the next student" on the activity screen only tidies the screen - it never touches this. Results live in this browser on this device, so back them up now and then.

Assignment lists

Tick the exact products a student has to find and save the set under a name. Saved lists show up in Round settings next to the product groups, so you can assign "Week 1 — Drinks" instead of picking a category.

Import a product list

Bring in a spreadsheet of products — a CSV or a tab-separated export works. Rows are matched on barcode first, then on name: a match updates that product, anything else is added as a new one. Pictures are not part of the file; add those on the product form below.

Name, Description, Price, Group, Location, Barcode

Add a product

A clear picture of the front of the package works best — that is what the student has to match on the shelf.

Move your changes to another device

Everything you add here is stored in this browser. To put the same products on a classroom tablet or another computer, copy the transfer code and paste it into the same box over there.
